podcast.title: Emergence as a Category (2013)
podcast.body: By 2013, "hipster music" had become a recognized category, often characterized by older or retro sounds. "By 2013, Hipster music was actually a thing."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: The History of the 2010s Part 2: The Role of Indie Rock

podcast.title: Retro Appeal
podcast.body: Hipster music often featured older, if not explicitly retro, styles. "Some of it was older, if not markedly retro."
